verified_facts.text: The resort is at 17875 Collins Avenue in Sunny Isles Beach, Florida.

verified_facts.text: Acqualina is a Mediterranean-inspired resort on the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Acqualina is a Mediterranean-inspired haven on the pristine shores of Miami Beach

verified_facts.text: Miami designer Isabel Tragash and her team designed the guest rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Celebrated Miami designer Isabel Tragash and her team of designers imbued the hotel room design with their unique vision

verified_facts.text: All guest rooms and suites have private balconies with views of the Atlantic Ocean or the Intracoastal Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: The spacious guestrooms and suites all have private balconies with breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean or the Intracoastal Bay.

verified_facts.text: Many suites have full gourmet kitchens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Full gourmet kitchens are featured in many suites with sub-zero built-in refrigerator/freezer

verified_facts.text: Every room and suite has a marble bathroom, Seed to Skin Tuscany amenities, high-speed Wi-Fi and an Illy espresso machine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every room and suite include a private balcony, marble bathroom, Seed to Skin Tuscany amenities, high-speed Wi-Fi, and an Illy espresso machine.

verified_facts.text: Small dogs up to 25 pounds are welcome.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, we welcome small dogs up to 25 pounds.

verified_facts.text: Avra Miami, Il Mulino New York and Ke-uH are open to the public as well as hotel guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Avra Miami, Il Mulino New York, and Ke-uH are open to the public and welcome outside guests.

verified_facts.text: Guests reach Avra Miami, which serves Greek cuisine, by a short walk across a sky bridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a short walk through an exclusive sky bridge adjacent to Acqualina Resort and within the resort community, guests can now enjoy a taste of Greece at Avra Miami.

verified_facts.text: Ke-uH serves Japanese fusion cuisine at dinner, indoors and outdoors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ke-uH located inside Acqualina offers Japanese fusion cuisine for dinner service with indoor and outdoor dining options.

verified_facts.text: The beachside Costa Grill is reserved for hotel guests, residents and Beach Club members.
verified_facts.excerpt: Costa Grill is exclusively reserved for hotel guests, Acqualina residents, and Beach Club Members to preserve a serene, private atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: Acqualina Spa is a 20,000-square-foot, two-story spa with eleven treatment rooms and a private spa suite for two.
verified_facts.excerpt: Acqualina Spa provides guests with an exquisite 20,000-square-foot, two-story tranquil sanctuary of relaxation set in a class of its own offering eleven multi-functional treatment rooms, and an extravagant private spa suite for two

verified_facts.text: Spa guests can use a crystal steam room, sauna, Himalayan salt lounges and an outdoor spa terrace with a heated jet pool and Roman waterfall.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spa guests have access to our crystal steam room, sauna, Himalayan salt lounges, experience showers, and our private outdoor spa terrace with a heated jet pool and Roman waterfall.

verified_facts.text: The Royal Spa Suite for couples has a steam shower, private balcony and side-by-side treatment beds.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Royal Spa Suite is a private haven designed for couples, featuring a steam shower, private balcony, and side-by-side treatment beds

verified_facts.text: The resort has three outdoor swimming pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Three outdoor swimming pools provide a haven for relaxation.

verified_facts.text: The oceanfront Adult Pool is for guests 18 and over.
verified_facts.excerpt: This oceanfront tranquility haven for guests 18 years and over

verified_facts.text: The Recreational Pool hosts staff-led pool games, activities and aqua fitness classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Recreational Pool is the epicenter of fun pool games, activities, aqua fitness classes

verified_facts.text: Beach service, limited to residents, hotel guests and beach club members, includes complimentary umbrellas, chaise lounges, towels and beach butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: exclusively available to Acqualina residents, hotel guests and beach club members and include complimentary beach umbrellas, complimentary chaise lounge, towel service and beach butler service.

verified_facts.text: The marine-themed AcquaMarine program is complimentary for children ages 4 to 12, with lunch available at a cost.
verified_facts.excerpt: AcquaMarine is complimentary for children ages 4 to 12, and a lunch option is available at a cost.

verified_facts.text: AcquaMarine camp reservations are required at least 24 hours in advance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reservations are required at least 24 hours in advance for camps offered Friday through Sunday and select holidays.

verified_facts.text: Guests can use an oceanfront soccer field and a dual basketball hoop.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers a private 5.5-hour Everglades National Park tour with naturalists from Wild Lime Adventures.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover one of the world's most unique ecosystems on a private 5.5-hour tour of Everglades National Park with expert naturalists from Wild Lime Adventures.

verified_facts.text: Resident photographer Pipe Yanguas offers photo sessions on or off the property.
